neet_che_u10_t00_1.working: Al, Pb and Bi are metals. Ge is a metalloid in Group 14.

neet_che_u10_t00_2.working: B, Si, As and Te are all metalloids. Each other set contains at least one metal (Al; Sn; Bi and Po).

neet_che_u10_t00_3.working: Five valence electrons means Group 15. N and P are non-metals and Sb is a metalloid, so the metal is Bi.

neet_che_u10_t00_4.working: Metallic character decreases across a period, so A is false. Non-metals lie at the upper right and metals at the lower left of the p-block, so R is true.

neet_che_u10_t00_5.working: I is correct for Group 15. II is wrong because Sn is a metal; Si and Ge are the Group 14 metalloids.
